div.div:
What crosses
The column-listed publications decide what PostgreSQL emits, and each mirror's column exclusions decide what PeerDB writes, so a non-allowlisted column never reaches ClickHouse, the Avro staging or PeerDB's logs (gate G6.4). peerdb-bootstrap admits one source at a time: order, then checkout, then payment, each after its heartbeat and every table's row count arrive.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 768px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1245px; margin-left: 12px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #475569;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#475569, #9ba7b8); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Who creates the path
Nothing is created by hand. In the cdc-local wave, peerdb-bootstrap calls flow-api to upsert the peers and create the three mirrors, and analytics-views creates the ten *_live views once the raw tables exist. product-db-cdc-bootstrap, in the databases wave, creates the heartbeat tables and schedules the pg_cron jobs.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 768px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1327px; margin-left: 12px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #475569;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#475569, #9ba7b8); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Credentials and TLS
Every PostgreSQL hop verifies the homelab-ca certificate: PeerDB to the CDC pooler, the pooler to the primary, and PeerDB to its catalog. ClickHouse and RustFS are plaintext inside the cluster, and RustFS uses a shared key; both gaps are recorded in ADR-067. PeerDB logs in to each database as peerdb_<db> and to ClickHouse (native :9000) as analytics_ingest; analytics-service reads only the views, as analytics_reader. The flow-snapshot-worker also runs Temporal activities, and flow-worker also writes mirror state to the catalog.
